reference_sql: WITH r AS (SELECT order_id,SUM(cents) cents FROM refunds GROUP BY order_id) SELECT c.region,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status='paid' THEN o.cents-COALESCE(r.cents,0) ELSE 0 END),0) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id LEFT JOIN r ON r.order_id=o.id GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY c.region
